name: conkora-admin-system
description: Sistema administrativo ConKora. Orchestration scripts; each folder has its own package.json.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix tests
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix tests
scripts.check:backend: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend
scripts.check:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.stack:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build --wait
